_readme: Holders typed in by hand from a named public source, read on the date given. The generator copies these into seats-defended.json and never rebuilds them. A record here outranks the published roundup and the derivation, and is outranked only by data/contests/local-byelection-holders.json (two sources each). Rules: data/seats/README.md.

local.northumberland.hirst.by.2026-10-01.note: The article names the vacating councillor as an independent, disqualified for failing to attend for six months, and says he was originally elected for Reform UK. The published roundup also gives Independent. The same article's result line reads Labour gain from Reform, which counts the seat as last elected; this record follows the party at the time of the vacancy.

source.label: Wikipedia, 2025 Northumberland County Council election, By-elections, Hirst

local.leeds.cross-gates-whinmoor.by.2026.note: The article lists the contest as caused by the resignation of a councillor it names as an independent. One source only; the article does not say which party the councillor was elected for.
